# nd_interface_ethernet (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nd_interface_ethernet" "test_resource_interface_ethernet_1" {
  fabric_name = "Trial_VXLAN"
  switch_id   = "FDO22412H7U"
  deploy      = true
  interfaces = {
    "Ethernet1/1" = {
      switch_id                         = "FDO22412H7U"
      mode                              = "access"
      network_os_type                   = "nx-os"
      policy_type                       = "accessHost"
      admin_state                       = true
      description                       = "access port for lab host"
      mtu                               = "default"
      extra_config                      = "logging event port link-status"
      access_vlan                       = 100
      allowed_vlans                     = "none"
      bandwidth                         = 1000
      bandwidth_capacity_percent        = 50
      border_router                     = false
      bpdu_filter                       = "default"
      bpdu_guard                        = "enable"
      cdp                               = true
      debounce_linkup_timer             = 1000
      debounce_timer                    = 100
      duplex_mode                       = "auto"
      error_detection_acl               = true
      fec                               = "auto"
      guard_mode                        = "root"
      if_name                           = "GigabitEthernet0"
      inherit_bandwidth                 = 1000
      ip                                = "10.1.1.1"
      ip_redirects                      = false
      ipv6                              = "fd00::1"
      ipv6_prefix                       = 64
      link_type                         = "auto"
      mask                              = "255.255.255.252"
      monitor                           = false
      native_vlan                       = 1
      negotiate_auto                    = true
      netflow                           = false
      netflow_monitor                   = "NFMon"
      netflow_sampler                   = "NFSamp"
      orphan_port                       = false
      path_cost                         = 2000
      pfc                               = false
      pim_dr_priority                   = 1
      pim_sparse                        = false
      port_channel_id                   = "10"
      port_channel_mode                 = "active"
      port_type_edge_trunk              = true
      prefix                            = "30"
      ptp                               = false
      ptp_profile                       = "smpte20592"
      ptp_role                          = false
      ptp_vlan                          = 100
      pvlan_allowed_vlans               = "none"
      pvlan_mode                        = "host"
      pvlan_native_vlan                 = 1
      qos                               = false
      qos_policy                        = "QOSP"
      queuing_policy                    = "QPol"
      routing_tag                       = "12345"
      security_group_proxy              = false
      speed                             = "auto"
      storm_control                     = false
      storm_control_action              = "default"
      storm_control_broadcast_level     = 10.5
      storm_control_broadcast_level_pps = 100000
      storm_control_multicast_level     = 10.5
      storm_control_multicast_level_pps = 100000
      storm_control_unicast_level       = 10.5
      storm_control_unicast_level_pps   = 100000
      unicast_bandwidth_percent         = 50
      v6prefix                          = 64
      vlan_mapping                      = false
      vrf_interface                     = "default"
      wan_link                          = false
    }
  }

}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_name` (String) The name of the fabric that owns the interfaces.
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) Map of interfaces keyed by interface name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))

### Optional

- `deploy` (Boolean) When true, deploy the interface configuration to the switches after create or update via /fabrics/{f}/interfaceActions/deploy.
- `switch_id` (String) Default switch serial number or management IP address applied to every interface entry that does not override it. Accepts either a serial or an IP; IPs are resolved via SwitchDB.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the nd_interface_ethernet resource. Format `<fabric_name>/<switch_id>/<interface_names csv>`.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Required:

- `mode` (String) Interface mode.
- `network_os_type` (String) Network operating system of the switch.
- `policy_type` (String) Built-in policy type for the (mode, network_os_type) pair, or `userDefined` to select a custom template via template_name.

Optional:

- `access_vlan` (Number) VLAN for this access port.
- `admin_state` (Boolean) Administrative state. Uncheck to disable the interface.
- `allowed_vlans` (String) Allowed VLANs. Use 'none', 'all', or specify VLAN ranges such as 1-200, 500-2000, 3000.
- `association_list` (Attributes List) PVLAN host association. Each entry pairs a primary VLAN with a secondary VLAN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--association_list))
- `bandwidth` (Number) Configure the bandwidth value for this interface.
- `bandwidth_capacity_percent` (Number) Percentage of bandwidth capacity for this interface.
- `border_router` (Boolean) Indicates if the interface is a boundary of a PIM-SM domain.
- `bpdu_filter` (String) Spanning-tree BPDU filter (enable/disable/default).
- `bpdu_guard` (String) Spanning-tree BPDU guard (enable/disable/default).
- `cdp` (Boolean) Enable Cisco Discovery Protocol (CDP) on the interface.
- `debounce_linkup_timer` (Number) Debounce timer for link-up transitions (1000..10000).
- `debounce_timer` (Number) Debounce timer (0..20000).
- `description` (String) Free-form description applied to the interface config.
- `duplex_mode` (String) Port duplex mode (auto/full/half).
- `error_detection_acl` (Boolean) Enable error detection for access-list installation failures.
- `extra_config` (String) Additional raw configuration appended to the interface.
- `fec` (String) Forward error correction mode (auto/fcFec/off/rsCons16/rsFec/rsIEEE).
- `guard_mode` (String) Spanning-tree guard mode (root/none/loop/delete).
- `if_name` (String) Internal interface name selector used by csr_multisite_ifc_underlay.
- `igmp_group_ranges` (Attributes List) IGMP proxy group ranges with prefixes. Maximum 20 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--igmp_group_ranges))
- `inherit_bandwidth` (Number) Sub-interfaces inherit this bandwidth value.
- `ip` (String) IP address of the interface.
- `ip_redirects` (Boolean) Disable IPv4 and IPv6 redirects on the interface.
- `ipv6` (String) IPv6 address of the interface.
- `ipv6_prefix` (Number) Prefix length associated with the IPv6 address (64..127).
- `link_type` (String) Link type for spanning tree (auto/pointToPoint/shared).
- `mapping_list` (Attributes List) PVLAN promiscuous mapping. Each entry maps a primary VLAN to a secondary VLAN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--mapping_list))
- `mask` (String) Subnet mask for the IP address (csr_multisite_ifc_underlay).
- `monitor` (Boolean) Enable switchport monitoring for SPAN or ERSPAN.
- `mst_path_cost_list` (Attributes List) MST instance lists (0-4094) with different port path costs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--mst_path_cost_list))
- `mst_port_prio_list` (Attributes List) MST instance lists with different port priorities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--mst_port_prio_list))
- `mtu` (String) MTU of the interface.
- `native_vlan` (Number) Native VLAN for the interface (1..4094).
- `negotiate_auto` (Boolean) Enable link auto-negotiation.
- `netflow` (Boolean) Enable NetFlow collection (requires fabric NetFlow enabled).
- `netflow_monitor` (String) Layer 2 monitor name for NetFlow.
- `netflow_sampler` (String) NetFlow sampler name (N7K only).
- `orphan_port` (Boolean) Configure the interface as a VPC orphan port.
- `path_cost` (Number) Spanning-tree port path cost (1..200000000).
- `pfc` (Boolean) Enable priority flow control.
- `pim_dr_priority` (Number) Priority for PIM DR election (1..4294967295).
- `pim_sparse` (Boolean) Enable PIM sparse mode on the interface.
- `port_channel_id` (String) Port-channel identifier the member belongs to.
- `port_channel_mode` (String) Port-channel mode (on/active/passive/auto/desirable).
- `port_type_edge_trunk` (Boolean) Enables spanning-tree edge port (PortFast) behaviour.
- `prefix` (String) Netmask length for the IP address.
- `ptp` (Boolean) Enable precision time protocol (PTP) on the interface.
- `ptp_profile` (String) PTP profile (ieee1588v2/smpte20592/aes672015).
- `ptp_role` (Boolean) Set PTP role to primary-only.
- `ptp_vlan` (Number) VLAN for PTP traffic (1..4094).
- `pvlan_allowed_vlans` (String) PVLAN allowed VLANs (none or ranges).
- `pvlan_mode` (String) PVLAN mode (promiscuous/trunkPromiscuous/host/trunkSecondary).
- `pvlan_native_vlan` (Number) Native VLAN on a PVLAN promiscuous port (1..4094).
- `qos` (Boolean) Enable a QoS policy for this interface.
- `qos_policy` (String) Custom QoS policy name.
- `queuing_policy` (String) Queuing policy name.
- `routing_tag` (String) Routing tag associated with the interface IP.
- `security_group_proxy` (Boolean) Enable host group proxy functionality.
- `speed` (String) Speed setting (auto, 10Mb..800Gb depending on template).
- `storm_control` (Boolean) Configure storm control on this interface.
- `storm_control_action` (String) Storm-control action (shutdown/trap/default).
- `storm_control_broadcast_level` (Number) Broadcast storm-control level (percentage).
- `storm_control_broadcast_level_pps` (Number) Broadcast storm-control level (packets per second).
- `storm_control_multicast_level` (Number) Multicast storm-control level (percentage).
- `storm_control_multicast_level_pps` (Number) Multicast storm-control level (packets per second).
- `storm_control_unicast_level` (Number) Unicast storm-control level (percentage).
- `storm_control_unicast_level_pps` (Number) Unicast storm-control level (packets per second).
- `switch_id` (String) Switch serial number or management IP address owning this interface. Overrides the resource-level switch_id when set.
- `template_config` (Map of String) Name/value pairs defined by the selected user-defined template. Only valid when policy_type is `userDefined`.
- `template_name` (String) Name of the user-defined template. Required when policy_type is `userDefined`; must be null otherwise.
- `unicast_bandwidth_percent` (Number) Local override for percentage of bandwidth set aside for unicast.
- `v6prefix` (Number) IPv6 netmask length used with the IPv6 address (iosXeNumbered).
- `vlan_mapping` (Boolean) Enable VLAN mapping.
- `vlan_mapping_entries` (Attributes List) VLAN mapping entries for modifying VLAN tags on this interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces--vlan_mapping_entries))
- `vrf_interface` (String) VRF name for the interface. Uses default VRF if not specified.
- `wan_link` (Boolean) Indicates if the interface is connected to an external network.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces--mst_port_prio_list"></a>

Optional:

- `customer_vlan_id` (Set of String) Customer VLAN ID ranges (1-4094).
- `dot1q_tunnel` (Boolean) Enable flexible S-VLAN tag configuration based on inner C-VLAN tag.
- `provider_vlan_id` (Number) Service provider VLAN ID (1-4094).
